Bm.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder with clear eyes, a strong white-hair silhouette and an earthy green/brown palette that sits in the key art's village; it is held back only by a stiff neutral full-body pose and a small render, and A and B are visually indistinguishable.

Jy.bar_b_note: The purple sky and teal moss hit the Stormwood palette, but flat additive glow discs, one mid-tone value band, a flat silhouette ridge for distance and no fog layering or shafts leave it well short of Palworld/Valheim finish.

Ds.bar_b_note: Same view as Jy with the sides swapped: the palette is right, but sprite-disc lamp glow that lights nothing, a sparse junction and a flat grey distance read as prototype rather than shipping finish.

Ik.bar_b_note: A's shaggy golden fur is close to the owner's naturalistic bar but the blotchy yellow spotting and its floating faint-mid pose hurt it, while B's smooth terracotta clay body with flat green patches reads as a toy piggy bank; neither boar clearly out-stands the 1.80 m trainer.

Ap.bar_b_note: B's larger panel with wrapped recipe lines and big ingredient rows is legible, but plain white 'Craft'/'Leave' hints with tiny keyboard glyphs, no teal focus or gold progression accents, and tall half-empty recipe rows fall short of Palworld's crisp HUD hierarchy.

Vb.bar_b_note: A screen-tall flat chartreuse beam punched through the canopy and acid-green lamp halos dominate a washed-out lilac sky with no storm drama, so the light reads as debug effects rather than Valheim-class atmosphere.

Kj.bar_b_note: The branching path with a gold guide line and a far landmark gives real wayfinding, but a flat orange pillar through the tree, a faceted grey boulder, an empty flat plain and an unlit lilac sky sink it.

Tx.bar_b_note: This is visually the same as Kj: good path wayfinding, sunk by the flat orange beam clipping the canopy, the faceted grey boulder and a sparse plain under a featureless sky.

Gl.bar_b_note: A is the owner-bar Tanglevolt (lightning-veined indigo fur, clear silhouette well over the trainer, readable rear-up hit and grounded faint), but B's hit react barely changes from standing and its faint frames drop to a white mesh with black blotches, a broken material no shipping game would show.

Gd.bar_b_note: This is Vb with the sides swapped: the chartreuse beam through the canopy and the acid-green halos read as debug effects, and the scene has no storm light, fog depth or copper/glass highlights.

top_changes.change: Re-light the Stormwood junctions: replace the flat additive glow discs and the screen-tall flat chartreuse/orange beams with real lamp light pooling on trunk, path and stones (small soft bloom only), and add a darker storm-cloud sky gradient, layered depth fog, a distant lightning glow and copper/glass specular highlights so the frames get a real value range instead of one lilac mid-tone.

Build a proper junction lamp-post family (stout timber or copper posts set into stone footings, readable at 30% and placed off the trunks), then re-dress the junction: break the uniform pale pebble border into varied set stones, replace the faceted grey boulder, and add grove edges, ferns and mushrooms clustered around the waypoint instead of an empty flat plain.

Bring creatures to the owner bar in every state: keep Tanglevolt's fur material through hit and faint (Gl B falls back to white/black), and remake the Ik boar in naturalistic fur clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer, dropping the clay/piggy-bank look and the floating faint-mid pose.
